What to record: Identify the project, room, assembly, finish schedule, and active revision.
Record applicator, inspector, or handoff owner plus the relevant date.
Identify substrate, product, color, sheen, lot, and current instructions.
Record approved sample, specification, manufacturer sheet, drawing, or signed standard.
Record product, coat number, application time, environment, and inspection time.
Record dry state, adhesion, dust, nibs, runs, orange peel, pinholes, and coverage.
Record sanding grit, scuff completeness, cleaning, repair, and masked areas.
Record current recoat window, exception, inspector, and release or hold.
